scope: Isolated loopback API and separate Chrome processes on one Mac; generated tones and animated screen; no physical devices or WAN

five_clients.bitrate_scope: Sum of track rates reported by WebRTC; not total network interface traffic

eight_clients_signaling.scope: Eight authenticated WebSockets and SDP/ICE relay; no RTC media

full_media_attempts.attempts: Five-to-eight and separate eight-browser attempts; a later five-browser repeat also failed under host load
full_media_attempts.observation: In the instrumented repeat, the server logged authorization checks reaching the500ms deadline: phase3(channel) or4(mute/ban), elapsed506..542ms, poolsize8 and idle1..4. Earlier attempts preserved generic close reasons and do not individually prove the same cause.
full_media_attempts.interpretation: Timeout was confirmed during high host load. This does not establish normal performance with clients on separate devices or isolate CPU versus other scheduling/I/O delays.
full_media_attempts.host_load_source: Operator observation from sysctl/uptime terminal output during the instrumented repeat (2026-11-13 around18:24 America/Sao_Paulo); not a metric from the authorization log.

limits: Five-client sample is brief and does not establish sustained performance
Requested720p was not maintained in the animated screen sample
Eight-party real media and physical Windows remain unvalidated
